items.source: Uses of Autowire in org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation
Support package for annotation-driven bean configuration.
items.translation: 用于注解驱动的 Bean 配置的辅助包。

items.source:
Enumeration determining autowiring status: that is, whether a bean should
have its dependencies automatically injected by the Spring container using
setter injection.
items.translation: 用于确定自动装配状态的枚举：即，Spring 容器是否应使用 setter 注入自动注入 Bean 的依赖项。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
